title: Support reactions and restraints
description: Reusable SVG component comparing pin, roller, and fixed support restraints and their possible reaction components.
learningObjectives: Distinguish restrained degrees of freedom and possible reaction components for common planar structural supports.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Candidate includes documented analytical self-checks and reproducible check notes. Independent engineering, live browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.
